SELECT a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
       ((ar."HIST_sign"
         + (ar.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric
         + (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
        * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status
                  WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                  WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                  WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                  WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score,
       cm.budget_alloc AS budget_allocation,
       cm.budget_stat AS budget_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = e.monitor_code
WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link" AS art,
         (SELECT avg(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS t(k,v)) AS erf,
         (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k, v)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS t(k,v)
           WHERE v = 'High') AS high_ratings
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
       a.art_title AS artifact_name,
       s.erf AS erf_score,
       s.high_ratings AS high_sensitivity_summary
FROM sens s
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" a ON a."ARTregID" = s.art
WHERE s.erf > 4
ORDER BY s.erf DESC

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
       a.art_title AS title,
       r.risk_level,
       ar."HIST_sign" AS historical_significance,
       (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r ON r.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
WHERE r.risk_level IN ('High','Medium')
  AND ar."HIST_sign" > 8
  AND (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric > 20

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link" AS art,
         (SELECT avg(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS t(k,v)) AS erf,
         CASE sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS light_w
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS registration_id,
       s.erf
       + (l.lux * s.light_w * l."visLxh") / 1000.0
       + 2 * ((a."ageYears" * s.erf * power(e."RH" - 50, 2) * e."TEMPc") / 100000.0) AS tetl_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN sens s ON s.art = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r ON r.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
WHERE r.risk_level = 'Medium'
ORDER BY tetl_score DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH cpi_calc AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
         a.art_title AS title,
         a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
         ((ar."HIST_sign"
           + (ar.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric
           + (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status
                    WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                    WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming','Qing')
)
SELECT artifact_id,
       title,
       dynasty,
       cpi_score,
       CASE WHEN cpi_score > 7 THEN 'High Priority'
            WHEN cpi_score >= 4 THEN 'Medium Priority'
            ELSE 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM cpi_calc
ORDER BY cpi_score DESC

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link" AS art,
         (SELECT avg(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS t(k,v)) AS erf,
         (SELECT count(*)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS t(k,v)
           WHERE v = 'High') AS high_cnt
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
       a.art_title AS artifact_name,
       e."TEMPc" AS temperature_celsius,
       e."RH" AS relative_humidity,
       COALESCE(s.high_cnt, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN ((a."ageYears" * s.erf * power(e."RH" - 50, 2) * e."TEMPc") / 100000.0) > 5
                 AND COALESCE(s.high_cnt, 0) >= 2
            THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
LEFT JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
LEFT JOIN sens s ON s.art = a."ARTregID"
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"

SELECT DISTINCT e.case_link AS showcase_id
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e
WHERE e."tempVar24" > 1 OR e."RHvar" > 3
ORDER BY showcase_id

WITH sc AS (
  SELECT s."caseID" AS case_id,
         (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric AS leak,
         s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' AS seal_state,
         s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' AS maint_status,
         s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' AS filter_status,
         s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' AS silica_status
  FROM "Showcases" s
)
SELECT DISTINCT sc.case_id AS showcase_id
FROM sc
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = sc.case_id
WHERE (10 - ((e."tempVar24" + e."RHvar" / 5.0 + sc.leak) / 3)) < 5
   OR ((CASE WHEN sc.seal_state = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN sc.maint_status = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN sc.filter_status = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN sc.silica_status = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) >= 3
ORDER BY showcase_id
